title: On Paying the whole sum in coin
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：pay　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pay 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the writer ① paid the whole sum in coin in silence, and every reader in the study said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the writer ② pays the whole sum in coin twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ pay the whole sum in coin at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ paid the whole sum in coin before — a line in the manuscript for January 1980 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Paying the whole sum in coin in silence, the writer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the page at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ pay the kindness back in kind twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Pay the kindness back in kind at once and never mention it again.

By 1993 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manuscript, and a new reader from the next study ⑧ pays the kindness back in kind in silence every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ paid the whole sum in coin again when nobody else would.

⑩ To pay the whole sum in coin, my mother said in 1998, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the study remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the study forgets, somebody pays the whole sum in coin twice over again and somebody must pay the whole sum in coin in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 支付（一般过去式 paid the whole sum in coin：1986 年写作者头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 支付（一般现在 pays the whole sum in coin：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 支付（不定式 to pay the whole sum in coin：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 支付（过去完成时 had paid the whole sum in coin：1980 年一月的手稿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 支付（动名词 paying the whole sum in coin 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 偿还（pay the kindness back in kind：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去偿还照原样回报那份好意）
G. v. 偿还（pay the kindness back in kind：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 支付（后段两处：新来的读者照例 pays the kindness back in kind，而母亲又一次 paid the whole sum in coin）

answers.why: pay 意为“支付”，1986 年写作者一言不发地支付用现钱把整笔数目付清，那是书斋里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 paid。
pay 意为“支付”，自那以后写作者来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 pays。
pay 意为“支付”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯支付用现钱把整笔数目付清”，此处为不定式 to pay the whole sum in coin。
pay 意为“支付”，手稿里 一月 那行字说明早在 1993 年之前就有人支付过，故用过去完成时 had paid。
pay 意为“支付”，写作者说“支付用现钱把整笔数目付清这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 paying the whole sum in coin 作主语。
pay 意为“偿还”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去偿还照原样回报那份好意”，should ever 之后用原形 pay the kindness back in kind。
pay 意为“偿还”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻偿还照原样回报那份好意（pay the kindness back in kind at once），以后再也不要提起。
pay 意为“支付”，新来的读者每个月份都照例偿还照原样回报那份好意，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 pays。
pay 意为“支付”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地支付用现钱把整笔数目付清，用一般过去式 paid 叙述。
pay 意为“支付”，结尾那句是母亲 1998 年的话：要支付用现钱把整笔数目付清，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和书斋记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 pay 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1986 the writer paid the whole sum in coin in silence, and nobody in the study forgot it.
Even now the writer pays the whole sum in coin twice over whenever the study asks.
Paying the whole sum in coin in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever pay the kindness back in kind twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new reader from the next study pays the kindness back in kind in silence every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother paid the whole sum in coin again, and the study remembered that half.
